decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be commenced not later than the expiration of one year from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The premises shall be used for a restaurant and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A3 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 11am to 11pm.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises, and shall not extend to the delivery of food or drink to customers by vehicle.

Condition : 5 - Before the development is commenced a scheme for protecting the adjoining residential accommodation from excessive internal noise shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used.

Condition : 6 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 7 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - The access doorway to the restaurant shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor,a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level and a 400mm high kickplate.

Condition : 9 - The proposed change of use from shop to restaurant would not have a negative impact on the vitality and viability of the shopping parade, would not harm neighbours' living conditions or result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of pedestrians and traffic in the area. The proposal therefore accords with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and facilities for people with disabilities), S.2.2 (Non retail uses in other shopping areas) and T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Change of use from retail (A1) to restaurant (A3)
